name: @switchback/mobile
//react: Pinned exactly, not caret-ranged: React Native ships its own renderer built against one specific React build, and `expo-doctor` checks for that exact string rather than a compatible range. apps/web pins the same version so the workspace resolves a single copy — two Reacts in one tree is a class of bug that only shows up at runtime.
//safe-area-context: `~5.7.0` is what SDK 57 was tested against. Newer is not better here: these are native modules compiled into the Expo Go binary, so a JS version ahead of the native one fails at the bridge, not at install.
//react-native-svg: The section is drawn in SVG on both clients, from the same geometry, so the graphic is one design rather than two that resemble each other. Version set by `expo install` and left exactly pinned for the reason above — it is bundled into Expo Go, so the JS has to match the native binary.
